ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Privilege Escalation To LOCAL SYSTEM
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects unknown program using commandline flags usually used by tools such as PsExec and PAExec to start programs with SYSTEM Privileges

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ \\-i\\ cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i\\ \\-s\\ cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ pwsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ \\-i\\ pwsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i\\ \\-s\\ pwsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-s\\ \\-i\\ powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-i\\ \\-s\\ powershell.*")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*paexec.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*PsExec.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*accepteula.*")))
